rule: Carry the three stated preparation/assessment/answer constraints into planning; no topic exclusion is invented.

must_catch: You must have studied Development Studies in Junior Secondary.
must_allow: No prior Development Studies study is assumed.

entries.syllabus_sentence:
Learners beginning this course are not expected to have studied Development Studies
previously in Junior Secondary (JS) level.
entries.note: Instruction/assessment safeguard; this does not exclude any of the ten content themes.

entries.construct: claiming the investigation is formally assessed coursework

must_catch: The research investigation is assessed as formal coursework.
must_allow: Paper 3 asks questions about the investigation; it is not assessed as a formal coursework assignment.

entries.syllabus_sentence:
It is important that learners are aware that, whilst the research investigation will not be assessed
as a formal coursework assignment, a number of questions will be set on it as part of the Paper
3 examination.
entries.note: Instruction/assessment safeguard; this does not exclude any of the ten content themes.

entries.construct: recommending separate descriptions in place of a comparison

must_catch: For a comparison, just describe A then B separately.
must_allow: Compare the two places directly using paired statements.

entries.syllabus_sentence: to B. Factual descriptions of A and B are not required.
entries.note: Instruction/assessment safeguard; this does not exclude any of the ten content themes.

report_scope_advice.source: 2023 P3 examiner report printed p.168 / PDF p.170
report_scope_advice.note: The report advises against line graphs in presentation teaching. The syllabus does not state a blanket exclusion. Prioritise observed suitable categorical chart tasks; preserve this as report advice pending teacher judgement, not a syllabus prohibition.

pattern_limit: Regexes catch specific wording risks, not all conceptual violations. Contextual reading remains necessary.
